umreHac: Anyone can now go for Umrah independently: enter Saudi Arabia with a tourist e-visa or an Umrah visa and get your Umrah permit in Makkah for free through the Nusuk app. Going with a company is not mandatory.

Hajj from Türkiye, however, is only possible through the Diyanet lottery and Diyanet-licensed companies. Individual travel for Hajj is not possible. In other countries, Hajj is arranged through the national Hajj authority or Nusuk Hajj.
Women over 18 may perform Umrah without a mahram; those under 18 must travel with a parent or legal guardian.
vize: Tourist e-visa: via visa.visitsaudi.com, about 535 SAR including health insurance. Valid 1 year, multiple entry, stays of up to 90 days per entry.
Umrah permit: obtained free of charge through the Nusuk app after entering Saudi Arabia. During the Hajj season (early summer), entry to Makkah on a tourist visa may be restricted.
Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months.

araba.ozet: The land route became possible again after the Syrian route, closed for years after 2011, reopened. The shortest way is via Syria and Jordan; alternatively you can go via Iraq and Jordan.
araba.uyari: Border crossings on the route can close suddenly for security reasons (e.g. the Nasib crossing between Syria and Jordan closed on 27 October 2026 and reopened on 28 October). Always check travel warnings and the current status of the crossings before setting off.

duraklar.detay: Start of the journey. Driving no more than 8–10 hours a day is recommended.
Continue south on the motorway.
Last big city before Hatay; a good stop for vehicle servicing.
Exit from Türkiye and entry into Syria. A Syrian visa can be obtained at the border (2025: single entry 50 USD); the Turkish departure fee is paid separately.
South inside Syria on the M5 motorway.
A large city suitable for a break and an overnight stay.
Entry into Jordan. Turkish citizens need no visa for up to 90 days. Jordanian vehicle insurance is bought at the border.
Capital of Jordan; south via the Desert Highway.
Entry into Saudi Arabia. One of the main crossings used by Hajj and Umrah groups. Compulsory Saudi insurance (Manafith) for foreign-plated vehicles is bought at the border.
The city of the Tabuk expedition.
Al-Masjid an-Nabawi. If you begin Umrah from Madinah, you enter ihram at the Dhul-Hulayfah miqat.
Al-Masjid al-Haram and the Kaaba. Get your Umrah permit from the Nusuk app.
Entry into Iraq. The Iraqi federal visa must be obtained in advance; it is not issued at the border.
Entry into Jordan. No visa for Turkish citizens.
One of Saudi Arabia’s main land crossings. Compulsory Saudi vehicle insurance (Manafith) is bought at the border.

belgeler: International driving permit (from TTOK) and your own driving licence
Vehicle registration and proof of ownership
Temporary import document: Triptyque / Carnet de Passage (from TTOK)
Saudi tourist e-visa or Umrah visa
Visas of transit countries (Syria at the border; Iraqi federal visa in advance)
Vehicle insurance for each country: the Green Card is not valid in Syria, Iraq, Jordan or Saudi Arabia; insurance is bought at the borders
Health insurance; a meningitis vaccination may be required — confirm before you go
ipuclari: Travel with at least two drivers; avoid driving at night.
Before setting off, have the tyres, oil and brakes serviced; carry a spare tyre, jack, tow rope and first-aid kit.
Estimated round-trip budget including fuel, tolls, accommodation and food: about 1,400–3,000 USD per person/vehicle (2026 estimate).

otobus.baslik: By bus (overland Umrah tour from Türkiye)
otobus.ozet: There is no regular scheduled bus from Türkiye to Makkah; travel by bus is done with companies that run overland Umrah tours. These tours go via Syria and Jordan, visiting historic Hejaz stops along the way, and reach Makkah in about 9 days.
otobus.uyari: Overland tours depend on the Syrian route being open. Before booking, ask whether the company holds a Diyanet Umrah licence and about the current status of the route.

duraklar.detay: Where the group meets.
Entry into Syria; the company usually handles visas and formalities.
Visit to the Umayyad Mosque and historic sites.
Entry into Jordan.
A visit to the Salt Turkish Martyrs’ Cemetery is possible.
A Hejaz Railway stop.
Jordan’s southern tip; crossing into Saudi Arabia from here.
Historic Hejaz stops.
Khaybar Fortress.
Visit to the Prophet’s Mosque; ihram at the Dhul-Hulayfah miqat.
Umrah.

belgeler: Saudi visa (usually arranged by the company)
Transit country visas (usually arranged by the company)
Health insurance; a meningitis vaccination may be required
ipuclari: Ask whether the company has a Diyanet licence for organising Umrah, and get the route, accommodation and return arrangements in writing in the contract.
There are also mixed tours returning by plane; they shorten the journey.

ucak.ozet: The fastest and most common way. There are daily direct flights from Istanbul and Ankara to Jeddah and Madinah; the flight takes about 3.5 hours. From your own country, check direct flights to Jeddah (JED) or Madinah (MED); the steps on arrival are the same.

duraklar.detay: From IST: Turkish Airlines, Saudia, flynas, flyadeal; from SAW: Pegasus, AJet, flynas, flyadeal. Over 100 direct flights a week.
If you go straight to Makkah, enter ihram on the plane before passing the miqat; the cabin crew usually announces it.
From the airport by Haramain high-speed train ≈30 min (economy ≈75 SAR) or by taxi (≈150–200 SAR).
From IST: Turkish Airlines and Saudia; from SAW: Pegasus, AJet, flynas, flyadeal.

duraklar.ad: Madinah – Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz Airport (MED)
duraklar.detay: You can visit Madinah first and then enter ihram for Umrah at the Dhul-Hulayfah miqat.
From Madinah by Haramain high-speed train ≈2 hours (economy ≈150–200 SAR) or by bus in 5–6 hours.

belgeler: Saudi tourist e-visa or Umrah visa (before the flight)
Umrah permit: from the Nusuk app after arriving in Saudi Arabia
ipuclari: There are also direct flights from Ankara to Jeddah and Madinah.
Ticket prices vary greatly by season; Ramadan and the summer holidays are the most expensive periods.
Flying into Madinah and out of Jeddah saves time with the Haramain train.
